m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: What's that? You'd like a place large and safe enough to evoke the Sun Serpent. That may be difficult. Perhaps impossible!
I know of a certain chamber in the Cenote, but it has been taken over by the Hungry Dead. It is not safe to go there!
Surely the sun's light would be welcome in that dank, dark place, but it is too much a risk. I cannot reveal the location!
Never let it be said I sent a young Magician to the Azure Chamber, to face death at the hands of the Hungry Dead.
Ahhhhh. I think I have said too much.
You went to the Azure Chamber and survived!
I mean, I suspected you would have no trouble dealing with Tolkemec, but did not want to ask.
Excellent work. I am always impressed by your performance.
Perhaps I'm making things too easy? We will have to see if we can step things up...
Due to its affinity for heat and the ancient world, the prime spot to summon the Sun Serpent is probably... Azteca!
I remember once meeting a mystic from there... Pacal Redmask. He may have an idea about a suitable landing spot.
Search Azteca for Pacal. He's probably in the Zocalo, the central meeting place in Azteca.
Report back when you've met with success... and no sooner!
You must seek out Pacal Redmask in the Zocalo, in Azteca. He will help you figure out where to summon the Sun Serpent.
